name: Shiso (Perilla)

schedule.notes: Refrigerate seeds 1 week first — chilling improves germination.
Pinch growing tips; pinch flower buds to extend leaf harvest. Mature seeds are also edible.

harvest.cues: Leaves 3 to 6 in, deeply purple or green, intensely aromatic when crushed.
harvest.storageNotes: Stems in water, fridge 3 to 5 days. Best fresh — flavor fades when dried.

varieties.name: Red (Aka) Shiso
varieties.notes: Deep purple, used for umeboshi (Japanese pickled plums) and the pink dye of pickled ginger.

varieties.name: Green (Ao) Shiso
varieties.notes: Bright green, citrus-cinnamon-basil flavor. Standard for sashimi, tempura.

notes: Self-seeds aggressively — one season's plants become next year's bed. Distinctive flavor: somewhere between basil, mint, and anise. Essential in Japanese cooking.
